questions: How does VEngineRenderView008 construct the separate viewmodel projection from FOV, aspect policy and clip planes?

functions.label: engine_render_view_set_viewmodel_projection
functions.role: forward viewmodel FOV and clip planes to the renderer projection builder

functions.label: render_set_projection
functions.role: select aspect policy and build the perspective matrix

functions.label: render_view_setup_3d
functions.role: build the world projection from the ordinary CViewSetup fields

relationships.evidence: VEngineRenderView008 slot +0x84 forwards fov, zNear and zFar with the normal perspective flag
the world pass uses the same builder with the ordinary FOV and clip fields

findings.fact: The viewmodel pass builds a perspective projection independently of the player/world projection; its FOV is not offset by or algebraically coupled to player FOV.
findings.evidence: client DrawViewModels forwards CViewSetup fovViewmodel, zNearViewmodel and zFarViewmodel through VEngineRenderView008 slot +0x84; 0x2010f280 forwards those values to renderer 0x2007a3e0, while 0x20078ea0 separately forwards world fov, zNear and zFar.
findings.consequence: Unreal uses a second projection with the authored viewmodel FOV, never a player-FOV delta formula.

findings.fact: The pinned renderer uses aspect 4:3 normally, 16:9 when r_anamorphic is enabled, and 1:1 only for the alternate projection flag; the viewmodel caller supplies the normal flag.
findings.evidence: 0x2007a3e0 selects 1.3333334 or 1.7777778 when its flag is false and 1.0 when true; 0x2010f280 supplies false for the viewmodel call.
findings.consequence: Aspect correction belongs in the bake-independent camera projection contract and must be verified against the exact retail binary or active patch hook.
